raw_reason: Original Data and/or Images not Provided and/or not Available
canonical_reason: Original Data and/or Images not Provided and/or not Available
definition_used: The original data or images for the published study is no longer available or is not given to the editorial staff.
caution: The reason indicates unavailability of data/images, which impacts research content reliability and transparency, but does not specify cause or fault.
semantic_rationale: Unavailability of original data/images directly undermines verification of research content (research_content_reliability) and reflects a post-publication transparency failure (post_publication_transparency_due_process_oversight).
